name: leather gloves
_design_note: F1-25 light hand slot. Soft calfskin — bonus accrues to tactile feel, not just protection.
lore_template: Soft {material_name} gloves fitted to exact finger measurements, providing excellent tactile feel and modest protection for the hands. Thieves prize gloves of this quality because they permit lock manipulation without leaving fingerprints — a practical consideration in any profession involving entry without invitation.
